selection.edition: international Traject Data ASIN Data API at api.asindataapi.com
selection.ownership: Traject Data (Westminster, Colorado, United States; founded 2020), acquired by ScraperAPI, LLC (Las Vegas, Nevada) on 2026-04-30. The reviewed edition is the international Amazon product-data API at api.asindataapi.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official ASIN Data API (api_key query, GET /account free of charge, Collections/Destinations APIs free of charge, billed GET /request product/search omitted), Traject Data Colorado / ScraperAPI identity, and dated incident search (ASIN Data API / Traject Data / asindataapi.com + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Distinct from Access Search Inc. and Amazon Selling Partner API. No qualifying current unresolved ASIN Data API compromise identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Traject Data ASIN Data API at api.asindataapi.com
research.searchCoverage: Official ASIN Data API account/collections/destinations (free of charge) and billed product GET /request, Traject Data Westminster CO identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Healthcheck uses GET /account rather than billed product lookup. No qualifying current unresolved compromise identified.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /account (officially free of charge; pinned credential validator) rather than list_destinations or billed GET /request product/search.
Auth is the api_key query parameter. HTTP 200 bodies with request_info.message are demoted via bodyErrorPaths. request_info.success is not used because true would false-fail.
Native category is ecommerce (source Data/Marketing are not in Rust CATEGORIES).
The upstream user-agent is not sent. Writes and billed product lookups are omitted.
GET /destinations with optional page, sort_by (type|name), search_term, and sort_direction. Collections API is officially free of charge.
Returns raw provider JSON under data rather than the pinned {data, successful} wrapper.
collection_id is a required path segment on GET /collections/{collection_id} and is URI-encoded.
Returns raw provider JSON under data.
GET /collections/{collection_id}/requests/{page}. page is required (minimum 1) rather than defaulting to 1 in the native path template.
Returns raw provider JSON under data.
GET /account is free of charge and returns account_info.
EventOnly webhook. No HTTP request; vendor POSTs result-set download links when a collection completes.
